changes.title: Choose the Waterskin's starting hotbar slot
changes.text: The APD Settings pane shared by player and developer builds now offers Automatic, Slots 1-6 and Off for future runs. Existing installs retain the former automatic default and existing saved quickslots remain unchanged. Occupied class items are relocated to empty slots without item loss.

changes.title: Verify Waterskin slot preferences and touch selection
changes.text: Five new core regression methods pass, covering persistence, all six selected slots, legacy preference, class equipment preservation and Off. The API34 owner-coverage guard and real-touch selection are included for full Android verification.

changes.title: Record the shared-build scope and TEST283 verification request
changes.text: Preserve all prior compiled history, verified TEST281/TEST282 evidence, and existing saves while documenting this pending user-facing preference; do not stage or distribute until independently verified.
